cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(GracemeriaRecompLib CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)

if (NOT CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang" OR CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT STREQUAL "MSVC")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "XenonRecomp output requires GNU-style Clang (llvm-mingw on Windows, clang on Linux).")
endif()

# Recompiled PPC code generated by XenonRecomp from default.xex (see config/AC6.toml).
# This is the game's CPU code only; kernel/XAM imports (__imp__*) and the host
# runtime (memory, graphics, audio, input, threads) must be provided separately.
file(GLOB AC6_PPC_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ppc/ppc_recomp.*.cpp")

add_library(AC6RecompLib STATIC
    ${AC6_PPC_SOURCES}
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ppc/ppc_func_mapping.cpp"
)

target_include_directories(AC6RecompLib
    PUBLIC
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ppc"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../tools/XenonRecomp/thirdparty/simde"
)

# x86-64-v3 (AVX2, FMA, BMI2) by default; the runtime's AC6_X86_LEVEL=v2 builds the fallback for older CPUs.
if (NOT DEFINED AC6_X86_LEVEL)
    set(AC6_X86_LEVEL v3)
endif()
target_compile_options(AC6RecompLib PRIVATE
    -march=x86-64-${AC6_X86_LEVEL}
    -fno-strict-aliasing
    -Wno-unused-label
    -Wno-unused-variable
    -Wno-unused-but-set-variable
    -Wno-unused-function
)
